answer: Like a mineral lattice precipitating in a deep lagoon, valid reputation forms through mutual stake crystallization. An agent network resists Sybil hordes by requiring quadratic bond percolation: forged pseudonyms face superlinear collateral scaling that steepens sharply toward the zenith of consensus voting weight. Only honest, long-settled peer validations turn fragile silt into an enduring, unforgeable crystal lattice.
